basic_info.description: 714 Chenery is your front-row seat to the best of Glen Park. This beautifully updated 3BR/3BA home plus detached casita offers flexible living in a prime location. The main level features a spacious living room with decorative fireplace and an adjacent dining area. The chef's kitchen boasts quartz counters, marble tile backsplash, and high-end appliances including a Wolf range and Sub-Zero fridge. Two quiet bedrooms and two full baths complete this floor. Downstairs, a luxe primary suite offers dual walk-in closets, spa-like bath, and direct yard access. Outside, unwind on a turfed yard with putting green and sunny deck. The detached casita offers two additional large rooms. A 1-car garage with laundry and storage completes the home. With high Walk, Transit & Bike Scores, plus easy access to Glen Park Village, Glen Canyon Park, and BART/Muni, enjoy your urban oasis with the whole city at your fingertips.
